name: hearthtale
description: Hearthtale: your WoW character's own journal, written as you play (the addon), and hearthtale.app to read it anywhere

scripts.check: bun run addon:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.audit: bun scripts/audit-data.ts && bun scripts/names.ts && bun scripts/knowledge.ts && bun scripts/forever-data.ts && luajit addon/test/audit.lua > .cache/audit/report.txt && luajit addon/test/playthrough.lua && FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/playthrough.lua
scripts.addon:check: bun run lint:lua && bun scripts/build.ts --check && luajit addon/test/sim.lua && FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/sim.lua && luajit addon/test/writer.lua && FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/writer.lua && luajit addon/test/sample.lua > /dev/null && luajit addon/test/seed.lua > /dev/null && FOREVER=1 luajit addon/test/voices.lua compare > /dev/null
